Dense toxic gas.provides: ground-hugging travel, accumulation in low ground, lethal by inhalation, no fire risk

Flammable vapour cloud.requires: a substance above its flash point with an ignition source available
Flammable vapour cloud.provides: explosion and fire risk, dispersal removes the hazard, no toxicity necessarily

Corrosive liquid.provides: ground-level pooling, contact injury only, no airborne travel

Fine particulate solid.provides: airborne dust, inhalation and dust explosion risk, settles when wetted

Pipework corrosion failure.requires: time and an aggressive process fluid
Pipework corrosion failure.provides: gradual leak developing to rupture, inspectable in advance

Operator valve error.requires: a human action on the plant
Operator valve error.provides: sudden release of whatever that line carries, immediately identifiable

Runaway exothermic reaction.requires: a reacting vessel losing temperature control
Runaway exothermic reaction.provides: pressure rise and vessel rupture, minutes of escalation, heat and reaction products

External impact.requires: a vehicle, dropped load or blast striking the plant
External impact.provides: instantaneous breach of whatever was struck, no process warning

Still air inversion.requires: stable atmosphere with no vertical mixing
Still air inversion.provides: no dilution, hazard persisting and travelling at ground level

Heavy rain.provides: washout of soluble gases and dust, no effect on a liquid pool

Confined indoor space.provides: no dispersion whatsoever, accumulation to lethal concentration, no downwind sector

Shelter in place.requires: buildings that can be sealed and a passing hazard
Shelter in place.provides: protection from a transient cloud, useless against a persistent release

Evacuate downwind sector.requires: a known wind direction and time to move people
Evacuate downwind sector.provides: removal from the plume path, exposure during movement

Water curtain suppression.requires: a fixed system and a water-soluble or dust hazard
Water curtain suppression.provides: knockdown of soluble gas and dust, no effect on insoluble vapour

Plant-wide shutdown.requires: time to bring processes to a safe state
Plant-wide shutdown.provides: removal of the source, no effect on material already released

Plant operators.provides: trained response, respiratory protection available, closest exposure

Adjacent residential area.provides: untrained population, no protective equipment, requires warning

Emergency responders.provides: protective equipment and training, deliberate entry into the hazard

_v1_notes.RELEASED SUBSTANCE|RELEASE CAUSE: corrosive liquid x runaway reaction is N: a runaway produces pressure and vapour, not a liquid pool. Particulate solid x pipework corrosion is N - powder systems do not fail by corrosion of process pipework in this sense.
_v1_notes.RELEASED SUBSTANCE|DISPERSION CONDITION: corrosive liquid is N for still air, steady wind and rain alike - a pool does not disperse in air at all; only the confined indoor case is meaningful. Flammable vapour x heavy rain is N as a governing condition.
_v1_notes.RELEASED SUBSTANCE|PROTECTIVE ACTION: corrosive liquid is N for shelter, evacuation and water curtain - it is a contained ground hazard addressed by shutdown. Flammable vapour x water curtain is N: it is not water-soluble.
_v1_notes.RELEASED SUBSTANCE|EXPOSED GROUP: corrosive liquid x adjacent residential area is N - a pool does not travel off site.
_v1_notes.RELEASE CAUSE|PROTECTIVE ACTION: external impact x plant-wide shutdown is N as a protective action: the breach is instantaneous and already complete.
_v1_notes.DISPERSION CONDITION|PROTECTIVE ACTION: still air inversion x shelter in place is N - shelter works against a passing cloud, and an inversion means it does not pass. Confined indoor space x evacuate downwind sector is N: there is no downwind sector indoors.
_v1_notes.DISPERSION CONDITION|EXPOSED GROUP: confined indoor space x adjacent residential area is N - an indoor release does not reach housing off site.
